note: All numbers on the SAME metric: k=2 nearest-neighbor same-label purity minus random baseline. Original=metrics-only features (m0-m31); Ours=hybrid features (metrics+shape+parity+residue). Both trained with the v10 multi-task supervised method.

prior_ai_reference.note: Prior self-supervised contrastive (v4-v7) collapsed to +0.23% on range_band, below the non-AI baseline. Retired by the supervised method.

recluster.note: Re-clustering in metrics space yields ~50-member families covering all 100k rows; only 22% magnitude; recovers 77% of the original fine family structure (NMI 0.768). This fixes the 58%-singleton problem that made the original family_id unlearnable for most rows.

metric_note: k=2 nearest-neighbor same-label purity minus random baseline (CORRECTED: self excluded then topk(2); an earlier off-by-one used topk(3) and was mislabeled k=2 -- see knn_recompute.json for the before/after).

family_disjoint_fine.setup: train prototypical on 80% of >=5-member families, evaluate k=2 retrieval on held-out 20% of families (unseen in training), 3 seeds
family_disjoint_fine.verdict: generalizes to UNSEEN families; beats raw on the same held-out pool; tight 3-seed CI

row_disjoint_coarse.setup: train multi-task supervised on 80% of rows, evaluate k=2 retrieval on held-out 20% of rows per coarse label
row_disjoint_coarse.verdict: coarse embedding generalizes to held-out rows; held-out lifts match the in-sample v10 numbers

held_out_validation_v12.metric_note: Held-out (non-transductive): queries and pool come only from the held-out split. The v9-v11 all-row k-NN was transductive; these confirm the results generalize.

recluster_eval_v13.characterization_verdict: clusters recover fine family structure (NMI 0.768) and are non-magnitude (range_band NMI 0.134, modal purity 0.223); strongest single-label alignment is peak_ratio (0.31). So clusters ~= fine-family + peak-ratio structure, NOT magnitude.

cluster_disjoint_heldout_C.verdict: CIRCULAR by construction: clusters are k-means Voronoi cells in metrics space, so raw-metrics k-NN purity by cluster is near-ceiling (+0.886). Confirms the v11 recluster retrieval number was circular (the reviewer's point).

cross_target_D.setup: train prototypical on ALL cluster-proxy labels (never saw family_id); eval family-disjoint on original fine family_id >=5
cross_target_D.verdict: NEGATIVE: an embedding trained on cluster-proxy labels does NOT beat raw metrics on the original fine families (+0.210 vs +0.247). The cluster-proxy is a weaker signal than direct fine-family supervision.
